end.summary:
Practised identifying the origin, axes, quadrants, and ordered pairs.
Plotted/reflected points using x- and y-coordinate rules.
Harsh correctly stated that (3,2) and (2,3) are different points after discussion.
Harsh continued to place points on the axes in a quadrant.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading ordered pairs, locating points on axes, and reflecting points across an axis. Harsh used the row-and-column idea to explain why (3,2) and (2,3) are different, and correctly stated the movement for each point. The mix-up about points on an axis belonging to a quadrant was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to label the origin, axes, and four quadrants on a small grid, then place one point on each axis and explain its location.
